messages:
sophie: :wave: Quick status check — observability sprint: dashboards + tracing hooks + error-analysis views. Milestone is EOW, can owners confirm current blockers? cc @maria @jon @tao

maria: I'm on dashboards. Waiting on a stable metrics export from metrics-team for per-route p50/p95. I filed an issue but no PR yet.

jon: Tracing hooks: PR #452 is open, awaiting review. Failing a11y lint in one file, will fix today.

tao: Error analysis view prototype done, but needs the new trace enrichment fields (service_version, model_variant) from the runtime. Who owns that? @kev?

kev: Yep, that's me. I'm blocking on an infra change to the KV cache sanitizer — infra rollout scheduled tomorrow morning (03:00 UTC). After that I can push the enrichment change.

sophie: Good to know — timeline looks like: infra rollout tomorrow -> kev adds enrichment -> jon merges trace hooks -> maria wires dashboards. If anyone expects slippage, call it out now.

maria: Small risk: dashboards need retention clarified. Product asked for 90d traces but storage team only guaranteed 30d unless we enable cold-tiering. Can we decide today?

kev: We can enable cold-tiering but cost impact estimation is pending. I'll ping finance for a quick delta and post here.

jon: If we can short-circuit, I can ship a fallback in the hooks to add a "trace_index_v1" tag so dashboards can show recent data even if full enrichment is delayed.

sophie: Nice. Action items: (1) kev -> confirm infra rollout + cost delta by EOD (owner: kev), (2) jon -> fix lint + land PR #452 after kev's rollout, (3) maria -> prepare dashboard config with fallback field, (4) tao -> sanity-check error-analysis UX once enrichment exists. If anyone needs help ping me.

kev: Noted. I'll post the finance delta here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled infra rollout for kv-sanitizer starts at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z. Notifications will be sent on start and finish.

maria: Thanks — I'll start mocking the dashboard with the fallback tag. Will request a quick review once jon's PR is merged.

jon: Lint fix pushed. CI green, requesting review from @sophie and @maria.

sophie: Thanks all. If nothing else, we'll do a quick sync in #eng-platform tomorrow 10:30 PT to confirm post-rollout state. :thumbsup:
